folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B285: full claim review and chronology
folds.body:
Every T11XC-0001–0086 record, all ten report pins and all five bounded owner pins above were read. This is a full read of this 631-line return, not of its underlying primary sources, private pack or current runtime. S1/S2 equal hashes identify duplicate report provenance; they do not prove two independent reviews. Their matched bytes and the later pinned owner references remain historical, including the 1,278-line PROJECT and 109-line UI_RULES snapshots.

T11XC-0001–0018 preserve status-window persistence-after-failure, missed awakening on time jumps, incomplete held-state validation, focus/placement and stage-contract findings as dated claims. Normal-route persistence or contrast passes do not cancel a failed write path or certify useful placement. H1–H6 and D/T/Q proposals do not add standing gates. The F7 natural-play statement and CH1 first-win source-only label describe different scoped evidence and must not be merged into a new natural first-win pass. T11XC-0048–0054 record final B1 whitelist closure after the initial blocked state; that closure does not certify unexercised sleep/first-win branches or human taste.

The recurring portrait sentence records the October14 leaning accurately as history. It is not a current requirement to ask again before omitting illustration: the later [prose-first clarification](../../USER_VISION.md#prose-first-visuals-and-hall-interaction-2026-11-04) and current [UI rules](../../UI_RULES.md) make deliberate illustration optional, while actual task/state/feedback remains primary. Current desktop/laptop and 14/21px requirements qualify old viewport/gate language; neither creates a new full-art or portrait policy from this audit.

T11XC-0020–0035 retain separate carrier/backing, activation means, trigger, lasting effect, record reliability and local time policy. A transported object need not transport its monument/support; a lasting body change need not expire with its trigger. Reread/rechannel/weakened/blocked labels, optional card fields and diegetic player facilities are proposal vocabulary, not a selected universal schema or world law. Source contradictions stay unresolved until their exact source scope resolves them. These useful distinctions are folded into the cosmology owner below its existing content.

T11XC-0036–0047 distinguish isolated Air P1–P4 adapters, paid/fixture outings, scoped true-death/life storage and a separately revised private candidate from merge/install/current behavior. Preserve the reported later A–E native snapshot and final suite pass while retaining earlier worker timeouts, proposed default-off pacing numbers, local hunger/weather/durability semantics and deferred Xeus/renown ideas. No broad current offline/death policy follows from those report labels.

T11XC-0055–0070 distinguish fixed nonlethal elder/Mara/party/sluice sessions, native faint/recovery, optional mortal end, simulation life primitives, selected availability/support cleanup and separate transfer/custody. The frozen Paradise non-admission statement is historical and is qualified by later deliveries; it is not a fresh absence finding. T11XC-0071–0074 report no missing Air source hunk or port, and an interrupted 1–55 test run remains incomplete despite a build pass. T11XC-0075–0079 keep Brogue's bounded implemented-unverified assay, SPD source-ready substrate gap and five unselected deeper questions distinct from a 2,374-path manifest. T11XC-0080–0086 retain the exact reserve/accepted-versus-completed, compatibility, consent/reservation, earned-choice and publisher scope of a frozen no-actionable-source-defect review; syntax/cold import and reinspection after drift do not establish gameplay. No underlying artifact, source or browser proof is renewed here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B285: retained game-carrier distinctions
folds.body:
The full [extra-audit C return](gm/cross-audit-reconciliation-2026-10-15/SEMANTIC_T11_EXTRA_AUDITS_C.md), T11XC-0020–0035, preserves useful analysis for selected cheat/world joins. Carrier arrival, activation requirements, trigger, effect and lasting consequence may have different backing. A carried implement can still need a local monument, target, fuel, source or permission; an already-made body change can outlast the world-law trigger that made it. Neither universal expiry on departure nor universal portability follows. A remembered record may be false or version-stale. Reload, continuing life, an authored reset and game-specific elapsed catch-up are separate mechanisms.

Retain soul/body/item/system/world/patron/knowledge/concept vocabulary and works/reread/rechannel/weakened/blocked outcomes as optional per-function analysis, not a mandatory global card schema or collision rule. Player/account/snapshot/run-seed/design-library support is not automatically a faculty carried by the character. The actual selected source and producer/state/consumer decide which support crosses a boundary and what remains afterward. Unknown backing remains an explicit source question rather than an invented fee, counter or fictional prohibition. The underlying game/source reports were not reread by this fold; the return's bounded dossier and thin-source qualifications remain. No source truth, runtime adapter or new research wave is selected.
